title: How Many Knights to BEAT Martin?
summary: Odds challenge vs Martin (250): player has only king + knights, starting with 2 knights and adding one knight per game. Series follow-up to beating Martin with 1 queen, 2 rooks, 2 bishops. 2 knights failed/drew (theoretical draw noted); the player finally wins with 3 knights, carefully avoiding stalemate.
rules: White: king + N knights only; black: Martin full standard army.
Start N=2, add one knight each game.
Stalemate is a draw (player has to avoid it).
win_condition: Checkmate Martin. Video: succeeded with 3 knights.
